technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.dragon_r: G. Dash through the foe in front of you (the one you have locked onto, else the nearest you can see within 14 blocks) with one huge blow, a dragon of ki rising behind you. Costs 30 ki, 13 second cooldown.
technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.pack_fan: G. A fast flurry of ten blows with lunges and weaves, the last one heavy; the foe is held in place for all of it. Costs 35 ki, 15 second cooldown.
technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.hammerlo: G. Rush in, take hold, three body blows, then throw the foe the way you look so it slams into whatever it meets. Costs 30 ki, 13 second cooldown.
technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.skyward_: G. Kick the foe high into the air, flash up after it and hammer it back down into the ground. Costs 40 ki, 16 second cooldown.
technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.ki_weapo: G toggles a weapon of ki in your right hand: a blade, a scythe or a clawed lance. While it is out ki drains every second, and your bare-handed blows hit harder (more with Ki Power) and reach further (blade 1, scythe 1.5, lance 2 blocks). They still count as fists. Click the button on this row to change its shape.
